subjects.name: Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine

summary: A survey of 1960s-70s terrorism: the wave of US skyjackings to Cuba, the Japanese Red Army's hijacking, massacres and murderous internal purge, and Venezuelan-born Carlos the Jackal's bombings, killings and 1975 OPEC hostage raid.

evidence.note: first successful hijacking to Havana in 1961 opens the skyjacking era segment
Carlos's birth in Venezuela in 1949 and his Marxist father
Sudan hands Carlos to France in 1994; later trials and imprisonment noted briefly
hijackers in Cuba interrogated by secret police and sent to brutal labor camps
United Red Army self-criticism camp in Gunma mountains, 14 of 29 members killed
Paris cafe grenade attack to force release of a captured Japanese Red Army leader
raid on OPEC meeting in Vienna, hostages flown to Algiers and Tripoli
Japanese riot police crackdowns and mass arrests of student radicals
Red Army Faction plot to kidnap the prime minister and spark armed uprisings
Stasi gives Carlos a safe house; he operates from Prague with state support

notes: Story splits between a skyjacking/Japanese Red Army half and a Carlos biography half, so both are primary. Covered span starts at Carlos's birth (1931 and 1939 hijackings are brief); end is release year per lifetime rule. Trials coda is short, so reaches_present is false. Guests' surnames not given.
